Global Semiconductor Outlook
Global semiconductor sales in March increased 
79.2% year -to-year and 11.5% month -to-month, with 
Q1 2026 totaling US$298.5 billion (+25% QoQ).
▪Industry  growth  continues  to be driven  by strong  AI and high-performance  
computing  demand,  with Logic  and Memory  segments  leading  expansion .
▪Analog and mixed -signal peers reported mixed 1Q2026 revenue results in 
USD terms. SICT delivered the strongest QoQ revenue growth at +25.4%, 
significantly outperforming peers whose sequential growth ranged from -
20.0% to +9.1%. On a YoY basis, peers posted growth ranging from 0.0% 
to +23.0%, while SICT recorded -5.2% YoY as customers postponed 
orders to 2Q26.
▪Long -term outlook  remains  strong,  supported  by continued  AI 
infrastructure  investment,  government  policies  promoting  R&D,  and 
sustained  capital  spending  by leading  foundries .
▪Key Industry Challenges
➢Mixed business trends in different applications  
➢Global talent shortage in semiconductor design and manufacturing
➢Capacity imbalances: oversupply /shortage in certain manufacturing 
and raw materials segments
